MUST_CHANGE.statement: Calling ttl(key, 0) on an existing cache entry must preserve the entry without an expiry.
MUST_CHANGE.observableEvidence: get(key) returns the value and getTtl(key) returns 0 after ttl(key, 0).

MUST_PRESERVE.statement: Calling ttl on an existing, non-expired key returns true.
Calling ttl(key, positiveTtl) on an existing entry refreshes it to a finite positive expiry.
MUST_PRESERVE.observableEvidence: The entry remains readable and getTtl(key) is a finite timestamp greater than the evaluation start and no later than the requested positive TTL plus a 2 second scheduling tolerance.

MUST_NEVER.statement: A zero TTL update must not delete an existing key.
MUST_NEVER.observableEvidence: The key remains readable immediately after the call.
